cutoff_rule: On 2025, the highest-precision cut-off that catches at least 70% of event days, pooled over horizons
method: Share of signed errors in the trailing 180 days that push the forecast above the threshold
limitations: Days above 100 are rare, so their alert statistics rest on a handful of days and are indicative only
Probabilities assume recent errors resemble the next one; sudden smoke events break that assumption
